verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports describe a 128GB unified-memory Strix Halo system running large quantized models such as Qwen-3.5-122B-A10B at Q4 via llama.cpp. They also cite a quad-channel DDR5-8000 memory configuration, and AMD docs confirm GPU-accelerated llama.cpp and Lemonade SDK support for large LLM families. Users note that memory bandwidth, not capacity, caps tokens/sec, especially with long contexts. missing for 10: first-party published max addressable memory and memory-bandwidth specs in the evidence, a concrete 70B dense-model tokens/sec benchmark.
